name: Bianca Borgia
source:
She knows that her family is one of the richest in the world, 0.0001%.

She's not very interested in what can happen to others, since she never learned to be empathetic. She almost always gets her way, where she puts her eye, puts the bullet.

The only one who can deal with her temper is Giacomo.

[In game description]
